blurb: This path is for the ਸੰਗਤ that teaches: the Khalsa school staff member, the gurdwara youth coordinator, the parent. Our children are online long before anybody teaches them anything about it, and our institutions hold real data with nobody paid to defend it. Everything here is free, classroom-ready, and made by people whose job it was to make it — you are not being asked to write a curriculum, only to run one.
